name: Brand Guard
tagline: Brand monitoring across Telegram, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and the web
role: Monitoring dashboard by the Softwhere team

scenes.title: One search across five platforms
scenes.body: Keywords, exclusions and Telegram channels in one query, with bilingual expansion into transliterations.

scenes.title: Live progress over SSE
scenes.body: Progress events and partial results stream in, so Telegram hits appear before the web scan ends.

scenes.title: Mentions, reach and sentiment
scenes.body: Posts, views and tonality by day; click a day to filter the posts, or download the full report.

scenes.title: Insights and flagged posts
scenes.body: An AI-written recommendation and themes, then every platform's posts grouped by sentiment.

scenes.title: Roles for every tenant
scenes.body: Each company gets its own pages; admins, analysts and viewers see only what their permissions allow.
